$comment: A record of hand-prepared corrections to the LIVE Prep-3 widget bank (the file above is an EXPORT of the
live database and must round-trip byte for byte, so the record sits beside it, not inside it).
The same change is made in generate_widget_questions.py's legacy templates (TEMPLATES), which build

corrections.by: data-engineer agent (pipeline), under Samuel's approval to fix the consistency review's no-decision findings
corrections.why: Consistency review 2026-09-27, W1: 14 predicate -> misconception mappings on live widgets could never fire — the widget's mode / ask / element can never emit that predicate (contracts/widget-predicates.json can_emit, derived from the app's grading code) — so the student got a plain 'not quite' where a refutation was promised. Rule applied: re-map to an emitting predicate only where it is the SAME error, else drop. geo2-2-2 (9) and geo1-1-1:w002: each dead mapping dropped; the widget keeps its emitting mapping (for geo2-2-2 the same misconception already sits on the predicate the ask does emit). u4-1-2 w001/w002/w004/w006: no emitting predicate is the same error, so the dead mapping is dropped and one candidate mapping is HELD (pending_review, decision 47 — never read by the app) for a human to keep or drop.
corrections.ships: LIVE CONTENT. Nothing here reaches production by itself: the deploy loads this bank only when it is missing (add-only), so the change needs a data migration like 032, in a release, on Samuel's go.

held_for_review.why: PROPOSED, NOT ACTIVE (pipeline, data-engineer agent, 2026-09-27; consistency review W1). The old mapping ratio-inverted -> mc:u4-1-2:ratio-inverted could never fire on a sin question (the legs are whole numbers 1-12, so the ratio stays below 1 and its reciprocal never equals the target) and was dropped. On this ask the instrument DOES report used-cosine when opposite and adjacent are exchanged, the error mc:u4-1-2:opposite-adjacent-swapped describes ('swapping sine with cosine'). It is not the dropped mapping's error, so it is held for a human to keep or drop; until then the widget is plain right/wrong, as it has been in practice since it shipped.
